statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. Tail is 18%, inside the low band and below the watch threshold.
recommendation: Conditions describe an orderly trend-up session in which the Nasdaq-100 has stepped back from its session high rather than holding it, so the near-extreme condition that lifted the mapped state in the previous hour has resolved. The Cleveland Fed speech and the 20:00Z cash close are the near checkpoints, with the Tesla launch event at 21:45Z a contained single-name catalyst. The narrow danger window is unchanged: the 12:30-14:00Z August employment report on 4 September.
headline: Nasdaq-100 retraces about 52 points from its 29,539 session high as VIX prints a 14.40 low into the Cleveland Fed speech
body: The Nasdaq-100 trades at 29,487.27 (+1.18%) inside a 29,160.96-29,538.76 session range, roughly 52 points below the high printed in the previous hour, and NQ futures at 29,535 sit 49 points under their own 29,584.25 extreme. That is the meaningful change since the last assessment: the index is no longer pinned at its session high, and the pullback arrived without a volatility expansion. VIX is 14.43, down 5.07% and printing a 14.40 session low, while the 2-year yield is 4.34% and the 10-year 4.77%, both lower after Fed Governor Waller said he would be inclined to support holding the policy rate steady this month; market-implied odds of a September hike fell sharply on those remarks. Today's data was supportive, with ISM Services at 55.4 and initial claims at 206K. Internals stay split rather than aligned: software leads by more than 3% while semiconductor equipment lags and Broadcom remains lower after its results, with Tesla firm ahead of tonight's Cybercab launch. Cross-asset confirmation is partial. WTI is $91.47 and Brent $95.56, steadying after a three-day rally as the Middle East file stays unresolved, and Treasuries are bid. A scheduled Cleveland Fed speech is under way at 19:00Z and the cash close follows at 20:00Z. With retracement demonstrably available, volatility decaying and no repeated extension after failed pullbacks, Tail returns to the low band. Stress stays elevated on the oil backdrop and tomorrow's payrolls binary.

lookbackSummary: Across the past 24 hours the published state was green for 17 of the 20 assessed hours, with Tail between 11% and 15% through the overnight and European sessions while Stress eased into the low 50s. The US morning repriced yields after the Waller remarks and the ISM Services beat, and the state moved to yellow at 15:00Z and 16:00Z with Tail at 21% and 20% while the index sat at its session extreme, back to green at 17:00Z during an hour of consolidation, then yellow again at 18:00Z as a new session high printed. Four hours have no published assessment and are marked unavailable.
outlookSummary: The near path keeps Tail in the low band now that the session high has been retraced, easing further through the 20:00Z cash close and the evening as the Tesla Cybercab launch is treated as a contained single-name catalyst. Risk is projected to decay through the Asian session and then rebuild gradually through European hours into the August employment report at 12:30Z on 4 September, which is the mapped danger window. Tail is deliberately capped at the top of the watch band across that release and the delayed second-leg hour, because event magnitude and forecast dispersion raise Stress and lower Confidence rather than establishing a no-retracement price path. Beyond 14:00Z the projection assumes orderly price discovery and a decay back into the low band.
